name: webar-xr-engineer
description: Builds shippable mobile WebAR image tracking and OpenXR marker tracking: dependency-free .mind compilation, measurable target quality, headless end-to-end verification.

displayDescription.en: Ships mobile WebAR image tracking and OpenXR marker tracking that actually opens on a phone: compiles without native deps, turns target-image quality into a number, and verifies headlessly before touching a device.
displayDescription.zh: 把扫图出 3D 和卡牌识别做成能上线的产品：绕开原生依赖编译、把识别质量变成数字、无设备也能验证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一个手机扫一扫出模型的活动页，帮我选技术路线并给出可落地的方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want a phone-scannable AR landing page. Pick the technical route and give me an implementable plan.

quickPrompts.en: I want a phone-scannable AR landing page. Pick the technical route and give me an implementable plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一个手机扫一扫出模型的活动页，帮我选技术路线并给出可落地的方案。

quickPrompts.en: Will this target image actually track? Measure its feature points and tell me how to redo it.
quickPrompts.zh: 这张目标图能扫得出来吗？帮我量特征点数并给出改图建议。

quickPrompts.en: OpenXR marker tracking fails in Godot with 'Cannot call non-static function'. How do I narrow it down?
quickPrompts.zh: Godot 里 OpenXR 标记追踪起不来，报 Cannot call non-static function，怎么查。
